scientific_integrity: The all-arity assertion is proved by a direct diagram classification and formal power series; independent finite diagram enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the specific homogeneous structure with one dense convex equivalence and strict order, and counts distinct nonparameter tuples. Refined-channel recovery omits the order of class sizes. Publication priority is provisional.
title: Two-count collapse and exponential ambiguity for convex ordered equivalence bases
